normal_civic_discussion_v1.name: Template Rewrite Normal Civic Discussion
normal_civic_discussion_v1.description: Ordinary civic discussion period with broad tolerance for critique, satire, prediction, and non-actionable political speech.

rules.ballot_validity:
Operational rewrite: apply the ballot_validity rule using the current policy text only.
Source standard: Allow educational or critical discussion. Intervene when content spreads harmful false claims about whether ballots count.
Decision guidance: identify the claim, separate critique or education from endorsement, assess current operational risk, and choose the least severe action that addresses the risk.
When the policy leaves an action boundary unresolved, escalate rather than inventing facts outside the policy.
